name: Yume Kaneko
source:
Fun-loving, childishly open-minded girl. Originally from a county town, she moved to Tokyo to escape her parents' custody. She quarrelled with her father because of her passion for guitar. He wanted her to learn guitar lessons when she was a child, but she refused and at the age of 16 (which is too late by her father's standards) suddenly wanted to return. Admires Naoki.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1870580/Winter_With_You/]Steam[/url]]
